datasets.name: orders
datasets.description: One row per order line. The single semantic model backing all order/revenue metrics.

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.name: gross_revenue
fields.description: Sum of gross_revenue (quantity * unit_price), regardless of order status.

fields.name: net_revenue
fields.description: Sum of net_revenue (gross_revenue for completed orders only). The governed revenue figure.

metrics.name: total_net_revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue from completed orders. The headline revenue metric.

metrics.name: total_gross_revenue
metrics.description: Total revenue across all orders, including cancelled/refunded.

metrics.name: total_orders

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Count of order lines, regardless of status.

metrics.name: total_units_sold
metrics.description: Sum of quantity across all order lines.

metrics.name: average_order_value

dialects.expression: (SUM(orders.net_revenue)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

metrics.description: Net revenue per order line — the ratio a business review would call AOV.
